name: @sulala/agent-os
description: Lightweight Bun-based Agent Operating System — micro-agents, skills, workflows

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun
scripts.build:dashboard: cd dashboard && VITE_AGENT_OS_API= npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && (cd dashboard && npm install && VITE_AGENT_OS_API= npm run build) && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('dashboard/dist','dashboard-dist',{recursive:true})"
